scope: Independent final source/diff/protection review for authorized B2.1 scope A / VERDICT-201–210. No production edits by reviewer.

resolvedFindings.detail: Original catch could lose the folder view/leave a partially composed runtime. Root now retires it and preserves folder/error until destruction finishes.

Root visual QA found cssText had cleared theme CSS variables. MinimalWorldBuilder now assigns cssText first, then calls applyFolderTheme(this.info); reviewed final source confirms the theme variables survive.

checks.subject: Pure director metadata authority
checks.evidence: WorldFolderSession imports no engine/platform/domain module; only creates immutable metadata snapshots and accepts CreateWorld/DeleteWorld/WorldFork intent variants.

checks.subject: Candidate persistence before publication
checks.evidence: Seed persists candidate before assigning snapshot; commit calls persist(candidate) before replacing this.snapshot; builder advances expected only after saveSnapshot returns.

checks.subject: Strict load and account isolation
checks.evidence: Snapshot/record fields, schema, owner, IDs, template, title/description and timestamps are validated; adapter uses encoded account namespace; bad JSON/foreign owner/storage errors propagate instead of reseeding.

checks.subject: Tombstone and identity integrity
checks.evidence: Delete retains the full record with deletedAt; getWorlds filters tombstones; parse does not seed an initialized empty list; generated IDs are checked against all active and deleted records.

checks.subject: Stale-card validation and conflict handling
checks.evidence: openWorld rereads current account storage and getWorldRecord immediately before composition; mutation persistence compares current storage with expected snapshot and rejects detected other-page changes.

checks.subject: Immutable narrow reading and intent UI
checks.evidence: Reader freezes a new array and exact three-field records; view only reads entries, sends type-only WorldFolderPort intents and issues navigation callbacks; no runtime/business state ownership.

checks.subject: Safe dynamic multi-card UI
checks.evidence: User-controlled account/title/description/confirmation/HUD text uses textContent; InitialWorld retains open-initial-world ID, other rows route data-world-id and data-action; new/delete/refresh feedback is visible. Minimal HUD assigns cssText before applyFolderTheme, preserving theme variables for visible panel/text/border styling.

checks.subject: No fake WorldFork
checks.evidence: WorldFork intent only validates an active world then throws 分叉尚未开放; no title-copy runtime, permission grant, WorldRegistry or full-state persistence implementation is added.

checks.subject: Global editor directory retained
checks.evidence: EditorCatalog definition from createEditorFolderEntry onward is byte-identical; editor modules/builders/drafts/export resources are protected and global routing stays independent of selected world.

checks.subject: Fresh minimal sandbox composition
checks.evidence: New MinimalWorldBuilder creates a fresh frozen Bootstrap runtime graph and uses existing InputCollector/FrameDriver/CameraRig/ProtagonistView; movement and jumping remain director/character authority.

checks.subject: No invented puzzle/chart/ledger behavior
checks.evidence: MinimalWorldBuilder assembles only ground/marker/guide/protagonist/camera/HUD; no DeepTrace, PuzzleChain, ChartPremiere, media asset or LedgerAppend wiring; InitialWorld retains unchanged actual factory.

checks.subject: Lifecycle retirement and visual cleanup
checks.evidence: exitRuntime synchronously deactivates runtime and schedules deferred destroy; retiring blocks reentry until EVENT_AFTER_DRAW; MinimalWorldBuilder onDisable deactivates sibling world root/removes HUD, onDestroy destroys root and owned mesh/material assets.

checks.subject: Composition failure recovery
checks.evidence: openWorld clears view only after successful synchronous component composition; catch retires partial runtime, preserves original folder/error and resets folderPending so the after-draw callback only restores camera/guard.

checks.subject: Frozen gameplay director unchanged
checks.evidence: IntentPort baseline prefix is exact; its only B2 delta is a comment and erased export type forwarding through the established narrow route.

checks.subject: Frozen source/dependency/gate boundary
checks.evidence: All 211 protected files match the fresh B2 baseline. Four authorized existing TS files changed; SceneBuilder unchanged. Three new TS files and their metadata are within existing modules, with no new dependency or gate relaxation.

limits: This source review does not claim Cocos execution or two-resolution acceptance. Use the separate actual Creator preview evidence and three gate outputs.
Browser storage conflict detection refuses detected stale snapshots; localStorage getItem/setItem is not a cross-process atomic compare-and-swap and no transactional concurrency guarantee is claimed.
B2.1 persists directory metadata only; fresh gameplay runtime state and complete WorldFork remain out of scope.
